hook.line: Does anyone else see the massive problem with this?
hook.visual: Close selfie of a woman at her desk, sceptical side-glance then wide-eyed; red label 'New Google SEO Ranking Signal' mid-frame, small word captions below.

beats.what: Rhetorical question with a red 'New Google SEO Ranking Signal' label over her chest
Graphic of the Google 'Add as a preferred source' button replaces the label while she explains it
Jump cut; predicts Google will use preferred-source picks as a ranking factor
Jump cut; the turn: 'this is gonna be so easy to abuse'
Bold prediction with a pointed finger: a spam update in mid-2027
Ends asking viewers to tell her if she is wrong

why_it_works: Opens on 'the problem with this' before saying what 'this' is, so the viewer waits for the object
Shows the actual Google button as a clean graphic at 6 s, so the abstract feature becomes recognisable
A dated, falsifiable prediction (mid-2027 spam update) plus 'tell me if I'm wrong' invites disagreement in comments (27 comments on 7391 plays)
Fast delivery (4.36 words/s) with expressive face and hands in a tight selfie frame, only 33 s long
weaknesses: Audio is quiet (-27.1 LUFS) and has no music bed
Word captions are tiny (0.034 of frame height) next to the large label
Only two cuts; the middle stretch has no new visual after the button graphic leaves at 15 s
for_robert: Open with 'the problem with this' and show the feature as one clean graphic, ideally held up by Fred, then end on a dated prediction and 'tell me if I'm wrong' to pull comments.
